Background {#assessment-background}
================================================================================

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (grepl("(?m)^ {0,3}###[ \t]+\\S", background, perl = TRUE)) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste(
    "::: {#background-tabs .section .level2 .tabset}",
    background, ":::", sep = "\n\n"
  ))
} else {
  knitr::asis_output(background)
}
```
